newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-TRANSVAAL BEAT BOLAND BY AN INNINGS.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-TRANSVAAL BEAT BOLAND BY AN INNINGS.

text.p: Transvaal beat Boland by an innings and three runs with a day to spare in the Supersport Series match at the Wanderers on Sunday.
Resuming at 123 for seven, Boland's first inings was hastened to an end by the slow left arm spin of Clive Eksteen who took four for 38 as Boland subsided to 146 all out.

Following on 162 runs behind Boland collapsed again to 92 for seven before the tail came to the rescue. Roger Telemachus (20) and David Millns (32) put on 42 for the eighth wicket, but it only delayed the inevitable.
Telemachus edged a catch behind of the pace of Wayne Kidwell to end the stand and Millns fell shortly afterwards to Eksteen.

Left arm seamer Ross Veenstra wrapped up the win for the home side when he trapped Claude Henderson lbw for 16. Veenstra was the pick of the bowlers second time round with four for 48 from 20.3 overs.
Medium pacer Andrew Hall picked up three for 14 from as many overs in a couple of miserly spells that kept Boland on the back foot.
Transvaal, who finished second in the competition last season, have now won their first two matches and look set to challenge for honours again.
